entries.zh: 码头；登船处（货物上下之所）
entries.notes: H 馬頭＋M bễ tāu 与 L embarcadero 三证相符；R 栏 mà tên 对音不合，疑抄录讹误。

entries.zh: 龙船；端午竞渡、献祭之日所划之船
entries.en: dragon boat; boat rowed on the day of sacrifice (festival racing boat)
entries.notes: L 栏 proa 前后文字残损难读，义据 H 龍船＋M liōng chiûn 定夺。

entries.zh: 捆、缚；捆扎货物上船；查封财物
entries.en: to bind, to truss; to stow cargo aboard; to impound goods
entries.notes: H 縛 与 L embarcar/embargar 相合；M 栏 Pag coügì kve 残损，R pō 对音存疑。

entries.en: to smear; to stain, to soil; (also) to stow cargo, to impound goods
entries.notes: H 栏标 [疑:沬/抹]，此处取「抹」涂抹义以合 L manchar。

entries.en: to thread or weave with rattan (bejuco)
entries.notes: L 词头有涂改；embejucar 即以藤条捆扎编穿，H 穿藤 可证。

entries.en: to cane a small chair with rattan
to cane a large bed or cot with rattan

entries.notes: H 妬 明确；M 栏并记 hougy、Toù 两式又带 hōu chìt，来源难定。
H 嫉忌 明确；M 栏 chìt sōû 无对应汉字，疑为衍文或别读。

entries.zh: 怪怨；因他人得宠而嫉恨
entries.en: to resent, to blame; to envy another's favour
entries.notes: L 词头标 [疑]，q tiene/gtiene 难辨；H 怪 与 embidia 义有偏移，故降等。
H 不甘心 为闽南语惯用语；M 栏夹西语 embidiar，R 栏 pū 与 m̄ 对音不合。
H 目腔狹 为方言比喻，义据 L embidia 推得；M 末字 ióg 无对应汉字。

entries.en: to envy one another; to be jealous of each other
to envy the worthy; to resent superior merit
